items.title: Jackie McLean — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He said, “I just heard the band upstairs, Jackie,”

ctx.x: Yeah. We did that. Then he came to the mic and he said, “Thanks a lot.” He said, “I just heard the band upstairs, Jackie,” he said, “and they played an old Sonny Stitt thing that I knew in college.” Damn, man. He is the first black president. You know? He really is. Because he was so beautiful that day here with the kids, with Dollie, with the program. He was just magnificent.
